summary: The bad entry point reads the ADD environment variable and passes it unvalidated to Connection.setCatalog(), allowing external control of a database configuration setting (CWE-15). The fix validates the value against a strict allow-list pattern (non-null, non-empty, only letters, digits, and underscores) before applying it as the catalog. Legitimate catalog names still work, but attacker-controlled values containing unexpected characters are rejected rather than applied.
